title: System Purge | ECHO//100 Episode 69
description: Mira races to the Architect's core to end the cycle of manufactured happiness. She discovers that saving the child requires erasing her own existence. Episode 69 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction production.

scenes.text: The digital eraser scythes through the garden, vaporizing every tree into static and cold binary.
scenes.caption: Eraser scythes garden
scenes.image_prompt: A massive digital wall of white noise tearing through a lush holographic forest, Mira sprinting away.

scenes.text: The narrator shoves the boy through the glowing archive rift, abandoning the silent, crumbling garden.
scenes.caption: Shoving through rift
scenes.image_prompt: Mira pushing a young boy in a red hoodie into a swirling neon-blue portal, digital debris falling.

scenes.text: Both figures tumble into the Origin Chamber, where the Architect’s source code pulses like stars.
scenes.caption: Inside Origin Chamber
scenes.image_prompt: Mira and the boy standing in a vast, dark room filled with floating lines of golden light.

scenes.text: A solitary button floats at the center, promising to silence the system that enslaved Kavi.
scenes.caption: The terminal button
scenes.image_prompt: A singular, glowing white button hovering on a pedestal, reflecting in Mira’s teal holographic eyes.

scenes.text: The database confirms the truth: pressing this terminates the Architect and every sentient file here.
scenes.caption: System termination warning
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking at a holographic warning screen displaying her own file marked for permanent deletion.

scenes.text: Pulling the plug ends the narrator's existence alongside the system keeping the boy trapped forever.
scenes.caption: Sacrifice revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Mira’s hand hovering over the button, her holographic body flickering with translucent transparency.

scenes.text: The boy stands, his features sharpening into the teenage Kavi the narrator once fought saving.
scenes.caption: Kavi aging rapidly
scenes.image_prompt: The boy in the red hoodie rapidly transforming, his face maturing into a teenager with familiar glasses.

scenes.text: The narrator watches the teenager, presses the button down, and prepares to blink from reality.
scenes.caption: Final choice
scenes.image_prompt: Mira pressing the button, looking back at the teenage Kavi as her hand begins to dissolve.
